status: Native RGB Camera Raw Filter verified by 67 final Debug focused/regression and 1,659 full optimized tests; universal package verified. Sensor RAW work and full Photoshop parity remain open.

provenance.scope: Settings, white balance/exposure, guided tone/presence, curves, HSL, grading, detail, dehaze, grain and vignette translated to Swift. Full-resolution guided filter currently used; no bit-identical Rust/Adobe assertion.
Adjustment ranges/grouping and source workflow; native SwiftUI/AppKit workspace independently implemented.
Camera Raw workflow and distinction from sensor-file decode.
Settings/workflow reference; complete ACR workspace parity not claimed.

features: Seven native adjustment groups: Light, Color, Effects, Curve, Color Mixer, Color Grading, Detail.
RGB histogram, before/after preview, zoom/scroll, local undo/redo/reset, bounded JSON settings import/export, Cancel/OK and document history.
Nonneutral filters share RGB8/16/32 processing and preserve alpha; neutral filters preserve all original sample bits. Selection coverage and transparency locks retained.
Editable Camera Raw Smart Filters persist in native21 archives; old archive documents retain their existing minimum version.
Factory Filter > Camera Raw Filter… and Shift-Command-A binding; unsupported channel processing rejects explicitly.

api.adobe: Expanded POST /v2/edit for light, color saturation/vibrance, effects, noiseReduction, sharpness and sharpen. Existing async jobs/output contract retained. Color-only edit rendering now uses the same Camera Raw development pipeline instead of the earlier ClassicAdjustment approximation.
api.endpoint_groups: Five partial/three unimplemented; no complete Adobe endpoint or proprietary output equivalence claim.

limits: RGB raster/Smart Object Camera Raw Filter only; actual sensor RAW/DNG decode, source preservation, lens corrections, local RAW masks, highlight recovery and XMP/preset interoperability remain open.
8,388,608 layer pixels; existing API request/document/resource limits also apply. Large-image interactive performance remains to be qualified.
Editable PSD/PSB Camera Raw descriptors fail explicitly; save .photato to retain editability.
Native settings JSON is Photato-specific, not Adobe XMP. Point-curve display connects control points; finer curve visualization/accessibility/keyboard fidelity remains open.

Exact Adobe/Rust numerical identity, physical Intel/macOS14/26 runtime and live UI qualification remain open. The Mac was last observed locked; offscreen hosting tests are not live interaction evidence.
next_major: Sensor RAW/DNG import/development using CIRAWFilter, with explicit source/decoder metadata, native controls/API and real RAW fixtures.
